# VigilODE C5 | Native source-owned graph-Schur scientific implementation and negative cost verdict

2026-11-02 KST. Selected physmath-research-loop C5 only. Original standalone cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode, explicitly EXCLUDE applied BASS/REI branches. Immutable parent R10 PR186 HEAD 15ec1b78704babff9f61f3e4a6eee992ce66cfde, preregistered C5 commit 50710fbeb4230f33ea207af88cba0fded4b2dde6 published before code. Scientific code and raw full-IVP record checkpoint 50229c6cf7e2e5c01440e3e6dff65783141be033.

## Definition and actual original native solver reuse

Original eight-stage RODAS5P raw-U source Git blob d68239d53977e36f98b186b627aa0c4c5c7de7cb; original WP3 frozen RHS/JVP/IC definitions Git blob 5dc8df34d314c0d8562c6f548a574625cef442ff and coefficients JSON SHA256 211255f6125b648c6955833c3da537d9c031ec78168b2918563c29fa88c8bce6.

Use the previously implemented PUBLIC StageLinearSystem client hook, so all original eight stage RHS, RODAS coefficients, controller, represented clock, output schedule, accepted/rejected work counters remain owned by the previous Rust fast driver. Only the stage linear solver is newly implemented as the **opt-in** source_owned_graph_schur module. For original cooperative cubic f_i=-k_i y_i-g_i*y_i^3+sum_j c_ij(y_j-y_i), with k_i>0,g_i>=0,c_ij>=0, c_ii=0, original unscaled fast-driver W=(h gamma)^(-1)I-J has diagonal inv_h_gamma+k_i+sum_j c_ij+3g_i*y_i² and offdiag -c_ij. This is not the distinct nonlinear backward-Euler root. Source-owned coefficients are analytically differentiated; no runtime JVP or Newton callback does NOT imply generic unknown-RHS derivative free.

New paired factory constructs OdeProblem RHS/JVP/epoch callbacks from ONE immutable source Arc and constructs the client from the SAME immutable coefficient input, by-value clone. This verifies source semantic identity, not pointer identity between client and callback Arc. Source name, epoch, time/mass/autonomy/shape and true RHS callback witness checked at every fresh linearization. A separately constructed arbitrary user-supplied problem remains a caller trust contract and is NOT formally proven source-bound by matching just one RHS point.

A declared feedback core B with |B|<=3 must leave an explicitly validated A disjoint path forest. Source-owned R9 graph-Schur with R10 affine prefix operations solves the true unscaled native W stage; tiny B core inversion and exact original W numerical residual are checked each stage. The real row-dominance theorem gives ||u-u*||inf <= ||W u-b||inf/m with m=min_i(inv_h_gamma+k_i+3g_i*y_i²), but evaluated residual and m in binary64 are NOT outward interval enclosures. Telemetry label certified_stage_solves means a finite binary64 residual SCREEN, not a full certified global error bound. Failed candidate work is charged and the existing original full-band BandedStageLu is invoked on the SAME W. A source/graph rejected before stage setup is routed in the research example to the unchanged matrix-free original full-IVP driver. Default production router never changed.

## Measured original full native IVP

The executable example is generated from the exact original WP3 Git-locked Rust source definitions. 4 labels: asymmetric_2, asymmetric_2_refined (resolution control, NOT independent physical data), coupled_3_cubic, linear_exchange_control. Three independent physical families. Same original full output grids 65/129, t=0..0.1, initial h=0.1/(64 or128), rtol 1e-4/1e-6/1e-8, atol=0.01*rtol. Three original native solver routes: new source-owned Schur client, unchanged fast-direct with the SAME clipped-output driver, and original matrix-free dense (same requested output nodes but DIFFERENT internal step landing/dense interpolation semantics). Three actual native wall repetitions per method/case/tolerance; 36/36 actual full IVP success and complete same output grids, bitwise deterministic. Independent SciPy Radau and DOP853 reference at rtol2e-13/atol2e-15 from frozen R7 checked entire output vectors, with numerical reference consensus. Raw outputs, counters, elapsed times and owner telemetry preserved.

After adding the paired immutable source factory, a NEW optimized Rust binary was rebuilt in a fresh isolated target. Binary SHA256 07a55a25746637591bf58b25575207597bc36cbf3d6de61d8821a6405e31a3e0, rustc 1.94.1, AMD Ryzen 9 5900X host. Final source-locked RESULT.json SHA256 88b7126b3016806f37a27d4de588bf3e2efc7dac37a865791df2318afaf53bff, NATIVE.jsonl source SHA recorded there. The per-independent-family median same-driver **new graph-Schur / existing fast-direct** wall ratio is **2.242032452000776**; all 12 original clipped-grid tolerance/case pairs have ratio >1. Accurate but SLOWER, so NO default promotion or measured speedup claim. Achieved global output errors 1e-14 to 1e-13, nearly identical to fast-direct. Exact output clipping fixes the time grid and makes achieved error nearly constant across the 3 tolerance values, so do not present this as a meaningful smooth adaptive work-precision curve. Matrix-free dense timing remains separate context, NOT a same-driver speed comparison.

Telemetry: no runtime JVP callback or nonlinear iterations for the new provider; actual original W residual checks and source RHS witness charged; NORMAL fallback zero. On original tiny n2/n3 cohorts affine_pair_compositions=0 because A path length is 1. Thus this physical benchmark does not measure speed on long path graphs. Separate genuine native Rust integration tests with synthetic n12/n24 cooperative rings (ALGORITHMIC controls, not physical data) actually exercised nonzero affine pair compositions and matched existing fast-direct full IVPs to <1e-11, but the large-n actual parallel wall speedup has NOT been established. R10 mathematical O(log n) span is not native parallelism: the current loop is serial and allocates per stage, which explains some overhead and is a future optimization target.

## Tests, failure modes and adversarial audit

Fresh-target cargo check/build PASS, source-scoped Rust lib unit 6/6 PASS, integration 7/7 PASS (including paired factory source/epoch binding, original W residual, native n12/n24 rings, original n2 whole IVP parity, invalid graph/source/RHS/epoch refusal). One same-author forced candidate-corruption test triggers original W residual refusal, charges failed work, initializes full-band protected direct W and returns the correct solution. Normal valid cases need no fallback. Original core/R10 source, Cargo manifest/lock and research accepted DAG remain untouched.

Early shared-target Cargo test failures about historical N01 missing types were proven ENVIRONMENT/STALE-BUILD effects: a clean isolated target rebuilt and executed all targeted tests. Early syntactic Rust source/test errors were fixed and specifically rerun. No blanket global CI PASS claim. No independent C9, full HOL source theorem, or outward rounding certification is claimed.

## Research variants and deliberate nonpromotion

- NEW nontrivial node: signed non-Metzler H-matrix residual can survive absolute row dominance, but source positivity and inverse nonnegativity cannot be imported. Native signed source NOT_RUN.
- HYBRID 1: original ROW graph-Schur + original full-band direct/strict matrix-free guarded fallback, actual native complete on original source.
- HYBRID 2: BDF2 cubic Newton-free/homotopy root vs original RODAS5P as DIFFERENT ODE solvers, no invalid stage substitution, full native comparison NOT_RUN.
- HYBRID 3: PEXPRB54S4 exponential phi-Krylov + Bernstein defect vs source-owned ROW with equal dense-output gate, full native comparison NOT_RUN.
- OpenEvolve0.4/UCT with GP-EI switch is applied as candidate-selection research HARNESS, no external LLM endpoint/independent reviewer or theorem-probability claim. Actual C5 source SHA feeds fitness. Native negative baseline R7 protected/transactional median ~0.21069 (R7 scope only) remains separate.

Decision: C5 selected runnable native implementation and measured scoped negative work are COMPLETE, but original G0 canonical DAG remains 7/23, successor admitted 0/12, production HOLD. Next genuine improvement should remove allocations, source probe overhead and evaluate a genuinely large sparse path-forest original full-IVP time-varying event/nonnormal holdout; compare actual same-achieved-error with full residual and fallback charging. Do not alter default/criterion or silently start another theory cycle.

# VigilODE R10 | Source-owned path-prefix theorem and theory-cycle closure

2026-11-02 KST. Selected PhysMath R10 only: durable science claims, stage-local constructive lemma, bounded search and next executable handoff, not a new R1–R10 cycle or C5 implementation. Parent PR #185 immutable HEAD 9694303d453c55ebcaf1ec4d851d0eb37cc87d52. Prospective preregistration commit dd076af6fd279ff478a6503652199d59d35ed003 was published before R10 source computations. Scope standalone original VigilODE G0, excluding BASS/REI applied work.

## Frozen source and original economic mission

Original eight-stage RODAS5P raw-U native source Git blob d68239d53977e36f98b186b627aa0c4c5c7de7cb, cooperative cubic RHS blob d78c5c5f6f476f2a5b1ea88628ed25daa6cfc482, original initial conditions fixture blob 1bfc17ec2ed4b902cc06073807388f6e332e31d6, original tableau SHA256 211255f6125b648c6955833c3da537d9c031ec78168b2918563c29fa88c8bce6. Original R9 exact source result SHA256 a39becdbc2c5855669c42fedfd69f740a3a159263c314927c221ec5fd80bd828. R7 real-native protected/transactional median wall ratio 0.21069269165 at same achieved whole-IVP error on 3 independent small original source systems. Preserve protected default, no unsupported native gain.

The actual Rosenbrock equation is W U_i=r_i with W=I-h gamma Df(y_n) frozen within step. The BDF/BE nonlinear root is a different mathematical stage. Source-owner supplies polynomial coefficients, including analytic 3*g_i*y_i^2 in W; runtime lacks JVP callback for this candidate but it is NOT a universal unknown-RHS derivative-free solver.

## Theorem R10.A: associative affine prefix within admitted path-forest graph

R9's source conditional cooperative cubic yields W=D(I-T), T>=0 and ||T||inf<1. Declared small feedback set B with |B|<=3 has acyclic complement A, source-authenticated time/epoch and original ROW stage RHS. For path-forest subclass A, each component is one directed path v0,...,v(m-1) with no additional incoming/outgoing A edges. The DAG inverse action R_A z=(I_A-T_AA)^-1 z on this component is exactly

   x_v0=z_v0;
   x_vi=z_vi+T_(vi,v(i-1))*x_v(i-1), i>=1.

Associate with root map F0(u)=z_v0 (pair (0,z_v0)) and each next affine map Fi(u)=t_i*u+z_vi (pair (t_i,z_vi)). Composition of outer (a,b) with inner (c,d) is (a*c,b+a*d), identity (1,0); it is associative but not generally commutative. Pair-composing F_i through F0 recovers exact x_vi in its additive coordinate.

By induction on recursive doubling stride 2^k, synchronous Hillis-Steele scan obtains every prefix in L=ceil(log2 m) rounds with

  N_pair=sum_{k=0}^{L-1}(m-2^k)=m L-(2^L-1)

affine pair compositions per path invocation (for m=1, zero rounds/compositions). Sequential topological propagation has depth m-1 and O(m) work. For a disjoint path forest, all component scans are independent, with total work the sum of their N_pair and depth max L.

This is a known associative-scan construction; see Ralf Hinze, An Algebra of Scans (2004), https://www.cs.ox.ac.uk/ralf.hinze/publications/MPC04.pdf and Seal, Perumalla and Hirshman (2012), DOI 10.1016/j.jpdc.2012.10.003. The project-specific contribution is exact application to R9 source-owned original Rosenbrock W inverse with measured work/span evidence and preserved source/error/fallback gates, not a new universal theorem.

## Theorem R10.B: same original stage root, different cost

The path scan changes ONLY evaluation order for R_A z, not the R9 graph-Schur equations

  S_B=I-T_BB-T_BA R_A T_AB;
  u_B=S_B^-1(b_B+T_BA R_A b_A);
  u_A=R_A(b_A+T_AB u_B);
  b=D^-1 r.

Consequently in exact rational arithmetic the new result is the same original W^-1 r as the R9 serial path solver, including all eight original ROW stages. Existing M-matrix row-margin residual-to-error certificate and the original R6 eight-stage lower-triangular residual propagation are preserved; no new native floating error enclosure or physical global truncation error theorem follows.

The scan must be applied once for each source-owned core setup column (|B| calls) AND once for each original stage RHS (8 calls per first step), plus remaining core operations, rejected speculative work and actual protected fallback. This source mathematical optimization reduces an INNER PATH dependency, NOT the full outer eight-stage causal depth. For general DAG branching/merging, refuse the specialized path scan; the previous serial graph-Schur or protected original RODAS fallback remains valid. Signed H-matrix residual bounds are a separate conjectural extension without M-matrix positivity.

## Actual R10 computation, evidence and negative controls

Four ORIGINAL frozen first-step cohort labels, 3 independent physical models and one resolution control, and four distinct SYNTHETIC graph controls: 8*8=64 original mathematical-form raw-U stage comparisons. The new scan was exactly equal in Fraction arithmetic to the R9 original-graph source solver on every stage; all retained original first-step error upper bounds agree exactly with R9. Additional SYNTHETIC n48 and n96 unidirectional rings validated exactly ONE source-owned W linear stage each, NOT original physical trajectories and not whole eight-stage runs.

| graph | sequential depth | scan layers | pair operations |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| ring12 (synthetic R9 control) | 10 | 4 | 29 |
| ring24 (synthetic R9 control) | 22 | 5 | 84 |
| dag8 (synthetic R9 control) | 7 | 3 | 17 |
| ring48 (synthetic R10 one-stage holdout) | 46 | 6 | 219 |
| ring96 (synthetic R10 one-stage holdout) | 94 | 7 | 538 |

These are algebraic operation counts and idealized independent scan rounds, NOT measured native parallel execution times. The ring96 data falsify any general claim of less TOTAL work: 538 pairs vs 94 serial predecessor edge operations. A source-valid DAG with two incoming dependencies to one node was REFUSED because it is not a disjoint path forest. Source script and deterministic JSON SHA256 a95e69a9a42e18de608dab52f6c2f9b4054005e5f377ac384c350ba04e7c6535. Fourteen same-author adversarial numerical and source-lock tests PASS; existing official 23-node DAG remains exactly 7/23.

## Actual proof assistant and mutation harness

Offline OCaml5.3/OPAM2.6/HOL Light3.1 generated three named LCF-kernel thm objects from local hol_r10_scan.ml: affine composition associativity, exact 3-node path and 4-node path polynomial identities. Exit 0, marker HOL_VIGILODE_R10_SCAN_KERNEL_PASS_3 exactly once and zero Error/Exception diagnostics. These three are PARTIAL formal lemmas, not full arbitrary-length scan correctness or native ROW implementation correctness.

Actual OpenEvolve 0.4.0 ProgramDatabase + UCT MCTS + Gaussian-process expected improvement selection (three cold starts and five GP acquisition waves), fixed 4+4 operator quotas across 8 waves: 29 distinct evaluated candidates, 6 actual arm switches, 5 false mathematical claims refuted with witnesses, 8/8 waves include a nontrivial new math node and hybrid requiring two distinct integrators and theory families. Scores come from source-locked R9/R10 original results and real R7 native negative wall evidence, not proof probabilities or fabricated speedup. Same-author test suite 11/11 PASS, including separate process byte-identical replay with PYTHONHASHSEED=0. No external LLM calls or trained neural MCTS. Sandbox full source/output/visualization ZIP SHA256 627167ecf557e55ad18690b90887dd8e225a8377b7a4447d5db17d0c9d149ff4.

## Final R10 decision and stop

ADMIT: conditional original source affine scan mathematical result, exact original source-stage computations and partial HOL lemmas; no universal mathematical novelty claim. HOLD: native provider, native full-IVP performance, C9 distinct-author referee, general DAG path-scan, signed-H positivity, and production/default route change. Keep the proven fallback and the R7 measured slow transactional q2 negative result.

The theory selected R10 stage is complete when report, verified source results and executable next-stage contract are committed and backed up. Do NOT silently begin another R1 loop or implement C5. The next genuine CODING step if requested is C5: native source/clock/epoch authenticated graph-Schur+path scan fast W provider, original raw-U stage residual, exact error/rollback, all speculative and fallback cost accounting, matching global achieved-error full-IVP benchmarks on original and larger stiff/nonnormal/oscillatory holdouts. Failure/overhead implies protected RODAS5P, not tolerance relaxation.

OFFICIAL_DAG=7/23 unchanged; SUCCESSOR_ADMITTED=0/12; PRODUCTION=HOLD. No merge, main, original solver, default, tolerance or authority-checker modification.

## Why this investigation is needed

Several proposed polynomial and causal optimizations already exist in earlier
PRs, while the remaining costs concern execution direction, distinct-vector
fusion, physical-error planning, session reconstruction and unproved future
cost assumptions. This supplement reads the latest PR92 source and four supplied
papers critically, then maps concrete alternatives to the six remaining tasks.

Stacked on PR92. Baseline: `7eb2dd0ffda39afb2871d76700a720986ff09fe0`.
The initial remote survey found no newer PR. This is a **theory/design and
supporting-computation PR**, with no Rust backend or default-route change.

## New mathematical constructions

- **Fused backward Clenshaw:** five distinct degree-m polynomial inputs can
  produce one fused result with m rather than5m operator products. The exact
  local-defect transfer is a sum of basis polynomials applied to the local
  defects. Laguerre uses the proved exp(L/2) bound on its declared self-adjoint
  chart; Chebyshev uses1 on [-1,1]. New backward local-error enclosures are still
  required. Current forward signed-adjoint certification remains the comparator.
- **Cubic finite-step planning:** a chord-integral proof improves the midpoint
  constant1/8 to1/12. Positive rational decay sums use O(logN) planning operations.
  For k=1,g=1/2,Y=T=1,epsilon1e-5, the exact minimum dyadic grid changes512 to256;
  changing the constant alone still selects512. Root/update/clock prefix gates
  remain necessary.
- **Broader polyalgorithm choices:** exact-degree SPD Chebyshev resolvents,
  near-structure polynomial correction without a commutation assumption,
  numerical-range ellipse/Faber bounds, two-channel physical transport,
  carrier-specific causal endpoint budgets, and geometry-specific routes.

  trace-preserving reuse, and a conditional residence/payback theorem. Generic
  branch/domain and future cost-variation certificates remain explicit gaps.

two-step product. Nonnormal and wrong-root counterexamples are also retained.
The supplied algebraic-geometry papers are not mislabeled derivative-free;
the DAE symmetry theorem is not extended beyond its stated linear scope.

guarded polynomial router, conditioned polynomial relations, shared coupled

facade/core Clippy, and docs/examples/serialized smoke. Other jobs fail:

before execution and no unopened holdout was used. Wall-time ratios remain

## Why this change is needed

PR91 established useful exact structural reductions, cubic accuracy planning,
and selective-entry work evidence. Three costs still needed separate treatment:
repeated full-state stage verification and lost failure work; allocations and
expensive candidates in scalar homotopy; and adapter decisions whose callback
proxy misses costly implicit arithmetic and changing regimes.

This change derives and implements narrower, testable improvements while
preserving the original residual and accuracy contracts. The production

The initial recent-PR survey found no PR after **PR91**, whose baseline is
`206298b4068d923bb47c7160b111b7439098660c`. This work is stacked above that
baseline; it does not merge PR90/PR91 or claim a general nonlinear solver

## What changes

- **Structural mean-field stages:** `structural_mean_field.rs` adds charged

- **Production setup:** additive `ProductionConfig`/`ProductionSolver`,
  serialized deployment examples, provider preflight checks, and callback
  accounting. Unknown fields and missing required controls are rejected;
  the inherited optional `entry_probe_adaptation` may be omitted as `None`.
  Supplied templates serialize the complete effective schedule. Scope is
  smooth forward identity-mass IVPs with endpoint observations. Callers inspect

- **Reproducibility and CI:** source/input/binary-bound command receipts,
  process-group cleanup, serialized native execution, paired benchmarks,

No new fitted gain margin, safety multiplier, dimension cutoff, or tolerance
relaxation is used to obtain the reported improvements. Caller accuracy and
resource inputs remain distinct from proved numerical constants and from
existing operational controller/scheduling choices.

## Measured improvements and adverse controls

Speed ratios below are **baseline time / candidate time**. Brackets are the
observed minimum/maximum of five ABBA/BAAB blocks, not confidence intervals.
Each row names its baseline. All comparisons retain their original accuracy
and failure-accounting contracts.

| Comparison | Work/instruction evidence | Native median speed ratio [range] |
|---|---|---|

The cubic work example keeps `k=1, g=1/2, Y=T=1`, physical cap `1e-5`,
and the same `N=512` plan. Rational maximum grid error is approximately

These are shared-host **measurement-profile** observations, with Rust 1.94.1,

| Adapter final source audit | 35 native contracts passed; 36 arms exactly match prior non-timing outputs; independent Decimal90 evidence is reused through that equality |
| First five-package native gate | Timed out after 905.316 s (900 s command cap), exit 124, unchanged source; completed target summaries: **510 passed, 0 failed, 28 ignored**. Incomplete run, not a full-suite pass |
| Pre-repair five-package retry | Completed with exit 101 after 689.679 s, unchanged source; completed target summaries: **1312 passed, 1 failed, 45 ignored**. Failure: `reaudit_lagged_failure_work::recoverable_jvp_error_retains_completed_column_and_all_work_partitions`, assertion at line 77, actual 603 versus expected 604 |
| Integration-accounting repair | Original failing regression and all eight reachable/adjacent lagged targets pass: **40 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored**; `evidence/lagged_scope_after/RECEIPT.json`. This gives **464 distinct post-repair scoped native passes**, without adding overlapping focused tests |

The retry's failure is retained in `evidence/native_final_r1/`, with the
isolated before-repair reproduction in `evidence/lagged_failure_before/`.
The source argument is recorded in `theory/FINAL_GATE_FAILURE_REVIEW.md`;
the reviewed reachability and evidence-reuse scope is in
`theory/LAGGED_VALIDATION_SCOPE.json`. The complete five-package sweep was
not rerun wholesale after this counter-only repair. Its final local release
run remains required; the new focused passes do not relabel the old failure.
No ignored or unexecuted test is counted as passed. Actual client
inputs, long integrations, restart/resource exhaustion, and deployment-host
release/LTO remain separately scoped local qualification work.

### Exact accounting repair and its limited scope

Before the repair, the lagged driver, regression test, generic operator
accounting, and relevant GMRES implementation were byte-identical to PR91.
The deterministic failure is not attributed to a shared test counter or to
the new adapter policy. The isolated test reproduces the same missing JVP
charge with unchanged source.

For one private lagged-stage invocation, let `A` count operator entries,
`L` the increase in solver-level attempted products, and `P` the increase in
the charged physical JVP/matrix ledger. Shape checks precede entry. Every
entered stage operator enters one JVP callback or matrix-product attempt, and its default
work hook records it only on successful operator completion. Thus, within
the valid native workspace and representable-counter domain,

```text
L = A
0 <= P <= A
missing physical entries = A - P
```

The old code reused `A-L`, which is zero even after an entered failure, as
the physical correction. The patch instead adds `A-P` to the physical
ledger before propagating the error. A fully successful stage adds zero;
the injected failure restores exactly one JVP call/vector. This includes
entered work omitted because a later operator-output check fails. Stored-LU
preconditioner accounting remains separate and unchanged. Arbitrary custom
composite providers and counter-overflow policy are not covered by this
local identity.

Only counter reconciliation changes: callback execution, states, tolerances,
iteration choices, and the existing test are retained. Measured adapter
routes use the dense/banded/matrix-free-fast router, not this lagged driver;
no speedup is attributed to this repair. It is the first of at most three
corrections for a separately diagnosed integration-accounting task, not a
fourth correction of the adapter research task.

## Proof scope and bounded research loops

Research correction counts are **structural 3/3, homotopy 1/3, adapter 3/3**.
The initial attempt is separate. Compilation/fixture repairs and the final
adapter syntax correction are labeled; they are not presented as additional
numerical performance tuning. Unsuccessful candidates and environment
failures remain in the evidence. The independently diagnosed inherited
integration-accounting repair has its own **1/3** correction count and
before/after qualification; it is not included in those three lane counts.

The structural certificate encloses **stage residuals**, including full-state
rounding defects; it does not yet supply a general outward physical
trajectory bound. The scalar cubic proof applies to its sealed monotone
model. The sentinel bound `2I+6` covers the current implicit window and does
not predict future-regime cost. The general causal route still uses frozen
JVP information and small projected linear algebra. Generic nonlinear
closure/order and branch/domain guarantees remain explicit theory tasks.

## Local qualification and six follow-up PRs

`DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.json` supplies a 16-node DAG, eight executable suites,
acceptance contracts, proposed branches, and machine-readable outputs.
`LOCAL_CODEX_HANDOFF_KO.md` pins the final delivered full SHA in a fresh
worktree, starts with a CLI dry-run, and preserves shared-lock execution.
After publication: `L-RELEASE → L-HARDWARE → R-QUALIFY` for the actual client.

| Follow-up | Dependencies | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| PR-N01 | L-HARDWARE | Small Krylov norm/MGS/QR cost and rank/true-residual conditions; retain existing enabled SPD04 workspace and known Givens counterexample |
| PR-N02 | L-RELEASE | Finite-step cubic decay-envelope proof, outward accumulation, and a smaller justified grid |
| PR-N03 | L-RELEASE | Variable-step structural residual transport plus temporal/endpoint error and a charged adaptive consumer |
| PR-N04 | L-RELEASE | Complete native-session continuation and generic homotopy workspace with FSAL/controller/epoch identity |
| PR-N05 | L-HARDWARE, PR-N04 | Nonlinear causal closure/order and total work/span against the strong forward baseline |
| PR-N06 | L-HARDWARE, PR-N01 | Conditional temporal residence/exploration-loss theorem with variation/dwell/domain assumptions and charged revalidation |

Review material is under `research/production_solver_closure_20261027/`:
`README_KO.md`, `PRODUCTION_SETUP.md`, the three lane reports/theories,
`report/production_solver_closure.tex`, `CI_HYGIENE.md`, source/evidence
manifests, and `evidence/LITERATURE_MAP.json`. The literature map preserves
metadata, query provenance, and hashes; fetched external abstracts and paper
text are excluded from the public bundle while project mathematics and raw
numerical evidence remain available through their manifests.

pull_requests.title: Derive exact error/work constants and implement derivative-free causal/homotopy improvements
pull_requests.body:
## 해결하는 문제

Causal Picard가 변하지 않은 projected input의 RHS와 이미 확정된 삼각 풀이 prefix를 반복 계산하고, adapter의 implicit entry pilot은 explicit checkpoint가 이미 얻은 step proposal을 버린 채 전역 h0로 다시 시작했다. 완료된 pilot이 실제로 더 저렴해도 기존의 임의 20% 비용 margin 때문에 선택되지 않는 경우도 확인했다. 이 PR은 세 병목을 분리하여 고치고, 구조를 이용한 derivative-free raw-U 소비자와 RHS-only homotopy/RK 소비자에 증명에서 유도한 오차 예산을 이식한다.

기준은 PR90의 `68a28357d960c4c2743c299770f0a33ef63245b2`다. Base는 `research/rigorous-performance-audit-20261027`, head는 `research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027`이다. PR74/75의 원래 목표식·stage 병렬화·실패 작업량 과금, PR77의 구조적 분해, PR90의 비용 하한과 checkpoint 보존을 실제 구현에서 재사용했다. 기존 적분식과 대조 경로를 유지한 채 네 경로의 이론·코딩 연구 루프를 병렬로 수행했다.

## 구현과 수학적 근거

- **Causal 재사용:** `BatchedPicardReuse`와 adapter의 `PicardReuse` 경로를 추가했다. 고정 epoch에서 전체 projected input이 bit 단위로 같을 때만 RHS를 재사용하고, 같은 RHS prefix의 기존 LU 결과를 보존한다. 모든 worker 결과를 회수하여 실패 작업까지 청구하고 full-space residual 검사를 유지한다. 유한 causal DAG의 오차 전달은 `Σ L^j`로 끝나므로 전역 수축을 요구하지 않지만 비정규 증폭은 남는다.
- **구조적 raw-U:** 선언된 affine mean-field 모델을 collective/transverse 두 스칼라 점화식으로 정확히 분해하고 모든 상태 성분을 병렬 복원한다. 원래 8-stage 목표와 임의 transverse 상태·forcing을 보존한다. 모든 step/stage residual에서 출력으로 가는 sharp 누적 norm `C_N`을 유도하여 `delta=epsilon_alg/C_N`을 사용한다.
- **RHS homotopy/RK:** 실제 후보 잔차가 Picard 잔차보다 크지 않은 `eta=1` 수용 규칙과 accepted-stage 초기값 재사용을 구현했다. Cubic midpoint의 강한 단조성, 비팽창성, 유한-step 절단오차로 step 수와 residual 허용치를 계산한다. 고정 모델에서는 `C=75/64`이며, 임의 절반 분할 대신 절단오차를 제외한 잔여 예산을 사용한다. Outward residual과 실제 상태·시간 반올림을 물리 오차 상한에 포함한다.
- **선택적 JVP adapter:** 미래 endpoint 정보가 아닌 batch 시작 전 checkpoint proposal을 entry pilot에 전달한다. 새 strict 옵션은 같은 구간을 완료한 후보의 기존 작업량 `W=RHS+JVP+ft+n·Jacobian+solve`를 checked `u128`로 비교한다. 목적함수의 strict 감소 조건에서 경계 `I<E`, callback 하한에서 중단 cap `E−1`이 나온다. 동률은 explicit를 유지하며, 실험 경로는 제공된 JVP만 허용한다. 두 새 옵션은 기본 false이고 strict 판정은 양의 pilot budget에 적용된다.

## 실제 개선 결과

| 경로 | 같은 목표·정확도 계약에서 관측한 결과 |
|---|---|
| Causal | 108/108 후보의 stage/output/error bits 동일. 전체 Riccati 궤적에서 RHS **1868→1702**, block solve **1456→1290**; JVP726과 모든 관측 상태·시도 결정은 동일. |
| Structural | 64-step 전체 RHS **1024→576**, shifted resolvent512→0. n2048/worker1에서 매 step 새 plan을 포함한 paired 중앙값 **1.883배**; 같은 cap에서 최대 공통-grid 오차2.398e-10. |
| Homotopy 정확도 계획 | 요구 물리 오차1e-5에서 증명으로 N512를 선택. RHS와 interval 평가를 모두 세면 **2092→1659**, 12/12 arm이 모든 반환점의 outward bound와 오차 요구를 통과. |
| Adapter | rate1000/10000에서 RHS-only 전체 work **2377→1691**, **19261→1629**로 28.86%/91.54% 감소. 초기 실패 pilot과 return probe 포함. 쉬운 rate1은 JVP0 유지. |

Structural 시간은 할당, plan 생성, 전체 residual 검사를 포함하며 동일 worker 수의 강한 derivative-free 순차 기준과 비교했다. 1.883배는 5개 paired block 중앙값이고 관측 범위는 1.472–1.943배다. 보편적인 시간 가속률로 확대하지 않는다.

새 proof-budget homotopy 실험에서 같은 seed의 Picard와 가속 정책은 평가 횟수가 같았다. 따라서 **2092→1659 절감은 accepted-stage 시드 재사용에 귀속**하며 Anderson만의 효과로 설명하지 않는다. 앞선 고정-grid 결과424→296과 warm-only/acceleration-only 대조도 별도로 보존했다. RHS, interval 평가, JVP의 실제 시간 비용이 같다고 가정하지 않는다.

## 검증, 음성 대조군, 남은 범위

**서로 다른 native 계약59개 PASS**, 변경한 두 crate의 **locked/offline all-target compile PASS**다. Exact rational 검산, 독립 scalar/dense oracle, 전체 상태의 정확해 비교, directed interval 검증을 함께 사용했다. Adapter의 12개 arm은 원래1e-6 cap을 유지했고 callback atomics와 native counter가 일치했다. 정수 판정에는 동률, 2^53 이상 한 단위 차이, overflow, 잘못된 replay endpoint 계약을 포함했다.

불리한 결과도 유지했다. Causal forward는 일부 목표에서 여전히 가장 저렴하고 작은 병렬 셀은 느려졌다. 별도 causal root-attempt timing은 외부 적분기가 거절한 step이므로 accepted-trajectory 가속으로 쓰지 않는다. 직접 RK4는4회인데 Picard20회, screened36회였고 continuation이12회를28회로 늘린 경우도 있다. 시드만 고치고 기존 .8 margin을 유지한 adapter는 전체 비용에서 RHS-only보다 비쌌다. 진단 후 추가한 seed/parity/exact 정책 및 정확도 계획은 별도 후속 프로토콜로 표시했으며 사전 고정 결과나 holdout으로 바꾸어 설명하지 않았다.

Causal 경로에는 **frozen JVP와 작은 projected LU**가 남는다. Structural의 derivative-free 주장은 선언된 모델에서 상태 행렬과 매 step factorization이 없다는 범위다. 공유 tableau loader의 고정 **8×8 metadata 역행렬**은 프로세스당 한 번 수행되고 timing 전 diagnostics가 초기화했다. Structural `CoreResult`는 실패 시 partial-work를 반환하지 않으므로 adaptive fallback 연결 전 과금 계약 보완이 필요하다. 일반 비선형 closure, carrier 변경의 고차 order 조건, 비수축 homotopy의 branch 제어, 미래 구간 비용 예측은 추가 연구 과제다. 기존 pressure/backoff/return 규칙 전체나 임의 RHS의 물리 오차를 인증한 결과는 아니다.

최종 원자료 감사에서 debug 취소 receipt의 `tests_executed:false`가 완성 로그와 모순됨을 교정했다. 짧은 로그는 완성 로그의 byte prefix였고, 긴 로그에는6+6 PASS가 있었다. 원 receipt와 두 로그를 보존한 correction receipt를 추가했으며 measurement-profile 실행만 대표 근거로 선택하여 중복 집계하지 않았다.

## 검토 자료

[개요와 결과](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/README_KO.md), [재현 명령](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/REPRODUCE.md), [R1–R10/C1–C10 실행 기록](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/RESEARCH_LOOPS.md), [정리와 증명](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/theory/THEORY.md), [REVTeX 원문](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/report/derivative_free_causal_homotopy.tex)을 제공한다. 세부 node는 [causal](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/causal/REPORT_KO.md), [structural 상수](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/evidence/STRUCTURAL_CONSTANTS_DERIVATION.md), [homotopy](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/homotopy/EXACT_CONSTANTS.md), [adapter](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/blob/research/derivative-free-causal-homotopy-20261027/research/derivative_free_causal_homotopy_20261027/adapter/EXACT_ENTRY_WORK_POLICY.md)에 연결했다. 명령·소스·바이너리 hash, 실패 결과와 원자료 archive를 함께 보존했다.

pull_requests.title: Reduce qualified solver work and add rigorous theory/performance audit
pull_requests.body:
## 문제

완료된 explicit 후보가 비용 하한으로 이미 패배한 implicit return comparator를 계속 기다리고, 미완료 비교가 완료된 비교처럼 기록됩니다. 별도로 Faer dense solve의 반복 할당, analytic partial-time temporary, projected residual 행 복사가 수치식을 바꾸지 않고 줄일 수 있는 비용입니다.

## 변경

- 기본 false인 `stop_dominated_return_comparator` 옵션으로 ordinary return comparator를 보수적인 비용 하한에서 중단합니다. 관측한 fatal callback의 우선순위와 checkpoint 보존을 유지합니다.
- 모든 미완료 비교를 별도 prefix-cost predicate와 evidence enum으로 표시합니다. 비용 합계와 ratio는 외향 반올림합니다.
- `LuSolveWorkspace`를 통해 aligned RHS와 permutation scratch를 재사용합니다. MF analytic partial_t는 기존 into API를 사용하고 coupled residual은 행을 빌려 사용합니다.
- 최신 31개 issue packet을 비판적으로 대조한 감사, 4개 조건부 정리의 완전한 증명, 이상적 DOPRI dispersion 유도, 연구 Rust primitive, REVTeX 원문과 원자료를 추가합니다.

## 실제 검증과 결과

- Native targeted tests **51 PASS**, standalone research Rust tests **7 PASS**.
- Dense n=65/96/192: 33개 공통 관측 시각의 모든 상태·native counters·attempt 수가 기준과 동일하고 정확해 상한을 통과합니다.
- LU의 7개 차원에서 기존 풀이와 비트 동일, warmed solve 추가 할당 0회.
- Adapter n=16: work 2655→2605, RHS 1216→1200; 전체 accepted trajectory 동일.
- Callgrind instruction slope: LU n=32 **13.196% 감소**, full dense n=65 **2.605% 감소**, full adapter n=16 **1.731% 감소**.
- 두 번의 paired timing에서 모든 block 범위가 1을 가로질렀으므로 **안정적인 wall-clock 가속을 주장하지 않습니다**. 원자료에 반전·회귀·비활성 셀을 보존했습니다.
- Shifted-system 실험은 27개 norm checks와 **25/27 residual 성공**을 구별합니다. 실패 2개와 반복수 증가를 보존하고 새 relaxation을 production default에 연결하지 않았습니다.

## 검토할 범위

새 enum/config field는 exhaustive match/struct literal에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다. 외향 비교는 일반 정수 동률에서도 이전보다 보수적인 결정을 할 수 있습니다. 생략한 callback 후반부의 미래 fatal까지 예측한다고 주장하지 않습니다. Callgrind 계수는 native 초 단위 가속률이 아닙니다.

기존 V6/V8 ledger와 닫힌 물리 캠페인은 변경하지 않았습니다. 반복 entry pilot, MF QR/provider 비용, whole-domain physical certification은 남은 과제입니다.

보고서와 재현 절차: `research/rigorous_performance_audit_20261027/README_KO.md`, `REPRODUCE.md`, `report/vigilode_audit.tex`. 원시 measurements는 `evidence/raw_measurements.tar.xz`, 해시 목록은 `MANIFEST.json`에 있습니다.

pull_requests.title: Plan physical client contracts and native domain integration
pull_requests.body:
기존의 제한된 역할을 전체 구성 대상 핵종·동위원소·이온과 인접 source/emission/absorption 연구로 확장하고, 이 저장소가 소유할 과정과 소비자 인터페이스를 명시합니다.

다음 과업: 실제 client의 RHS/Jacobian/domain과 V6–V8를 연결하며 native norm과 D5 검증은 재사용한다.

## Scope

Improve the weaknesses identified by the strict VODE/Diffsol comparison without changing the existing default kernel or applying an unproved stale-Jacobian policy. Existing upstream triage and Diffsol changes are preserved. The numerical parent is `b56bb19ce85bc28a021138ee29689701a81bc4f0`.

## Verified correctness fixes

The original standalone `rodas5p_fast_banded_solve` returned Ok(NaN) for nonfinite matrix/RHS input, Ok(Inf) for an unrepresentable finite-input solution, and panicked on overflowing shape arithmetic. Four baseline failures now pass. Tiny but representable solves remain supported. The scoped regression target passes **9/9**.

A separate suspected callback-retry bug was **refuted** by four baseline tests and inspection of the existing Err branch. Recovery policy was NOT changed.

## Opt-in implementation work

- `BandedKernel::FixedWidth2`: preserve Slices factorization/pivot/solve arithmetic for lower=upper=2; other widths fall back to Slices.
- `FixedWidth2ExactCache`: reuse only a previously successful finite factorization when the rounded shift and every Jacobian entry are bit-identical. No Jacobian or RHS evaluation is skipped at a new state.
-17 relevant internal tests pass, including forced pivots, exact factors/solution bits, cache invalidation and non-default widths.
- Default Indexed/Slices selection remains unchanged. New enum variants can require external exhaustive matches to be updated.

## Actual measurement

Production patch: `b51c051b045e977c038e5eec468de0004840872b`.
Successful benchmark source: `f8e89b70528da8490fbe1febf0b0ede9ff84a01e`.
Successful run: https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/vigilode/actions/runs/39304607635

All raw repeat timings and87 content-addressed full-state objects (~7.96MB compressed) are retained and read back with a separate metric implementation.

On the registered nonlinear Brusselator configurations, FixedWidth2 reduces observed per-call time by roughly5% relative to the old binary. The new-binary Slices path also changes slightly, so the full gain cannot all be attributed solely to constant-width specialization. Exact cache has zero hits on those nonlinear cases and is slower than FixedWidth2 alone. On repeated dyadic-step linear controls it reduces134factorizations to8 and gives roughly10–11% total time reduction; Jacobian134calls remain. The fix-closure matrix, the remaining limits and the review record are in `docs/REAUDIT_R2_CLOSURE_20260930.md`.

## 1. Fixes

| Finding | Commit | Fix | Regression (audit values) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **R2-OUT-01** (P1) represented time | `df2da78`, `90df209` | Request ownership, hard-stop landing and the end of the span are decided by exact comparison. `step_to` finds an h with t + h == target and never overshoots. `land()` stretches a step that would stop short by only the rounding residue of the time sum (at most 64 eps max(\|t\|, \|t+h\|, \|target\|) and at most h/1024), and treats an overshoot within that residue as a landing rather than a shortened step. t + h == t is a typed error; a final piece that lands on tf is exempt from min_step. The Radau drivers lose their end slack. | 8-ULP span at +-1e12: 0 attempts and y = 0 before, now y = 1. The next_up(endpoint) request gave 2048, now 2049. Adjacent requests were rejected as duplicates, now recorded. Also: 0.1 x 10 lands on 1.0 in 10 steps; a 0.04 grid with h = 0.01 adds no micro-step and BDF2 keeps its error; zero-crossing grids work; an adaptive step across zero reaches tf. |
| **R2-POL-01** mixed budget | `5639a33` | The step-power term is formed on binary exponents (`rodas5p_core::binary_power`), so it has no intermediate overflow. A NaN component is rejected before `min`. | 1e-320, 1e-160, p = 2 at h = 1: budget 10 (WRMS 5 accepted) before, now 0.999988867182683 (rejected). epsilon_ref = 0 gives 0. The homotopy consumer accepts at 1.01x and rejects at 0.99x of both the step and the embedded term. |
| **PHI-R1** weights | `5639a33`, `90df209` | `weight_phi_vectors` forms h^k b_k with `times_power`. An overflow, or losing every nonzero input, is an error. A partial loss is counted in `WorkCounters::phi_weight_underflows`. | h = +-1e-100, b4 = 1e300: 0 before, now 4.166666666666667e-102 (fused, dense, prefix). h = 1e100, b4 = 1e-300: NonFinite before, now 4.1666666666666665e98. |
| **PHI-R2** dense amplitude | `5639a33` | The dense combination is evaluated on w / 2^e and scaled back. `dense_phi_combination_report` flags mixed range and outputs far below the input amplitude. | w1 = c: result 0 at c = 1e60 before; now relative error <= 1e-12 for c = 1e-200 .. 1e300 against the closed-form phi1. |
| **R2-STAT-01** sessions | `e1bc29d` | Only labelled sessions count. An unlabelled case makes the decision Inconclusive. `measure_paired_case_in_session` added. The A/A control gives authority only in exactly the candidate's sessions. `raw_cases_sha256` and `verify_against_raw` link a record to its raw cases. | One PID, 6 unlabelled cases: 6 sessions and Promote before, now 0 sessions. Candidate 0..5 with A/A 100..105: Promote before, now Inconclusive. |
| **R2-STAT-02** vector coverage | `e1bc29d`, `90df209` | Unknown coverage is absorbing under accumulation (`merged_unknown_vector_calls`, omitted while 0). Pareto fronts and attainments list unknown-cost runs as `not_evaluated_record_ids`. | 16 legacy + 1 current call: 1 vector before, now unknown. Same result in every order and grouping. |
| **R2-STAT-03** confirmatory gate | `e1bc29d`, `e4c96be` | Only a confirmatory protocol gates (>= 10000 resamples, >= 0.95 confidence, >= 1.15 required speedup). Schema is now v2. The CLI wall criterion uses `verified_gate_decision`. The interval reports a simulation band for its endpoints. | B = 1: Promote before, now Inconclusive. 9 tamperings and duplicate sessions are rejected. The B = 10000 interval matches the audit's exact 6^6 bootstrap endpoints [0.848528, 1.449138] within its band. |

## 2. Independent review
Two AI review passes, each emulating `step_to`, `land`, the collectors and the drivers bit-exactly in Python.

- **Pass 1** found 10 defects in the first patch. Two were P1 regressions:
  - the Radau fixed drivers kept the old slack;
  - ordinary fixed-step runs accumulating to 0.9999999999999999 took an extra 1e-16 step, or lost the last output.
  
  All 10 are fixed, each with a test.
- **Pass 2** confirmed those fixes. It found three further step-size issues: the residue collapsed near zero, the h/8 stretch cap was too loose, and the `lands` flag was wrong. All three are fixed in `90df209`.

No human reviewer has approved the claim scope.

## 3. Validation at `e4c96be`

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| fmt; clippy `-D warnings` (workspace, stage-certificate) | clean |

| handoff validator; holdout-verdict, research-node, authority-refs tool tests | pass |

No existing test was edited except one. In `paired_timing_contracts::pairs_of_one_process_are_not_resampled_as_independent`, an unlabelled case now counts as 0 sessions instead of 1.

The audit's `run_reproductions.py` refuses to run on source that differs from `7708ef9` (by design). Its fixtures are ported as Rust tests instead, using the audit's numbers.

Audit work has its own counters, so the run is bitwise the unaudited run. `..._fixed_inner_observed` is the same loop with every stage solved to the fixed linear tolerance: the F-033 attribution arm.
- **`4d2a737`** `run_two_arm_admissibility_v3_case(_synthetic_smoke)` runs the v2 clipped and dense arms unchanged, audits the dense interpolant, classifies under `TWO_ARM_ADMISSIBILITY_PROTOCOL_ID` with that delta (no row is left `InterpolantUnchecked`), and optionally reports R_inner = E_dense / E_tight-inner. New record type `TwoArmAdmissibilityCaseV3`; the v2 schema and its frozen 0.1 rule are untouched.
- Contracts: the audit leaves counters, steps and states bitwise unchanged; an intact interpolant stays within delta 2; a 1% corruption raises delta above 2; the v3 runner's clipped/dense checksums equal a v2 run of the same row; the record checksum is reproducible.
- **`af24dcc`** fixed-mesh ablation example (re-audit 2.3), below.

## 3. Evidence (`research/scientific_validity_v2_20260829/addendum_20260929_two_arm_v3/`, SyntheticCiSmoke)
6 of the 18 n = 96 calibration rows have exact solutions; the other 12 were skipped.

| Row (n = 96) | clipped | dense | status | max delta | R_inner |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|
| rotating-nonnormal 1e-4 | 0.071 | 1.39 | Pass | 0.91 | 0.94 |
| rotating-nonnormal 1e-6 | 2.07 | 3.65 | Pass | 0.79 | 1.01 |
| rotating-nonnormal 1e-8 | 1.38 | 1.62 | Pass | 0.09 | 1.00 |
| semilinear 1e-4 | 7.25 | 17.0 | GlobalErrorExceedsBudget | 0.15 | 0.80 |
| semilinear 1e-6 | 0.10 | 53.2 | GlobalErrorExceedsBudget | 0.33 | 1.00 |
| semilinear 1e-8 | 19.8 | 207.5 | GlobalErrorExceedsBudget | 0.96 | 1.00 |

F-033 reading: not the inexact stage solves (R_inner about 1); not fixed-h order reduction (observed order 5.0); local error control holds (true local error of each accepted step <= 1.36 units, at most 1.6x the estimate); the summed local errors are 12 to 30 times smaller than the global error, so the exceedance is propagation. This corrects the audit's statement that it "cannot be produced by accumulating <= 1-unit local errors": accumulation alone cannot, propagation does.

### Fixed-mesh ablation (`af24dcc`, re-audit 2.3)
`examples/semilinear_f033_ablation.rs` fixes the accepted mesh of the campaign dense run and replays it step for step with arms that each change one ingredient: `forcing-jvp` (the campaign solve), `tight-jvp` (every stage to GMRES rtol 1e-13), `direct-w` (W assembled from the analytic JVP and LU-factorized), `fd-jvp` (forward-difference JVP, GMRES rtol 1e-8). Max global error at the mesh nodes, outer WRMS units:

| rtol | forcing-jvp | tight-jvp | direct-w | fd-jvp | campaign dense (output times) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1e-4 | 16.7 | 16.8 | 16.8 | 16.8 | 17.0 |
| 1e-6 | 53.1 | 53.3 | 53.3 | 53.1 | 53.2 |
| 1e-8 | 207.4 | 207.4 | 207.4 | 200.5 | 207.5 |

The node errors agree across the solve and W-construction arms, and the FD-JVP arm is within 3.4 %. The node/dense gap is at most 0.3 units. So the exceedance belongs to the RODAS5P steps on this mesh, not to the solves, W, the derivative or the interpolant. Output in `addendum_20260929_two_arm_v3/semilinear_f033_ablation.txt`.

pull_requests.body:
Draft. Not for merge. Base: the audit base. Head: `41a964c` (sections 1–5 describe `ae6ce07`; section 6 the re-audit follow-up).

## 1. Finding ids
- **F-052** (P2): internal BDF/Radau comparators use tolerance-independent Newton tolerances and a fresh Jacobian + LU per solve.
- **F-056** (P2): Radau IIA3 factorizes an extra (mu/h)M - J per trial for its error estimate.
- **F-053** (P2): no timing path produces a dispersion estimate; the 1.15 wall threshold is below recorded noise.

## 2. Diff summary
- **`d61cada` Tier B (F-052/F-056)**: new `comparator_fidelity` module (`production`, `reference-implementation-only`, `tier-a-modified-newton`; `ComparativeReading` permitted / forbidden). Every fixed, adaptive and G1 run row and every adaptive candidate descriptor serializes `comparator_fidelity`; fronts and attainments carry `comparative_reading` (`forbidden` whenever a BDF/Radau arm is present — today every one). `CandidateGateVerdict::NotEvaluated` and `UnifiedJointVerdict::NotEvaluated`: unified gates and the CLI Tier-L / Tier-N / joint verdicts refuse Promote/Hold against a reference-only reference. Checksums hash explicit old-shape projections, so the four smoke screen checksums (fixed `1348e366…`, adaptive `fd1b9f93…`, G1 `1e562334…`, unified `7ab479c1…`) and `native-integrator-gates` output are unchanged.
- **`c3abe23` Tier A, opt-in (defaults unchanged)**:
  - `RadauConfig::reuse_stage_lu_for_error_estimate`: the estimate reuses the retained 3n stage LU through the real eigenvector of A (matches SciPy's transform column to 1e-14): one fewer factorization per trial, estimate equal to 1e-8 relative.
  - `NewtonTolerancePolicy::ScaledToOuterTolerance` (Radau: SciPy kappa rule; BDF: 0.1). Prothero-Robinson: Radau IIA3 averages 3.33 Newton iterations per solve at rtol 1e-4 versus 6.19 at 1e-8 and 6.8 with the default policy; BDF2 at 1e-4: 1.92 versus 2.58. Errors stay within the tolerance band.
  - Either flag labels the config `tier-a-modified-newton`, which still forbids comparative readings.
- **`ae6ce07` F-053**: `paired_timing.rs`, pure and seeded (splitmix64): >= 2 warmups with batch size from the minimum warmup; >= 30 pairs in seeded ABBA order; per-case median log ratio; two-stage case-clustered bootstrap (B = 10000, 95% percentile); Promote iff CI lower >= 1.15, Block iff CI upper < 1.15, else Inconclusive; A/A control required for authority (CI must contain 1.0 and half-width <= ln(1.15)/2); host metadata from /proc and /sys. Tests: 1.30 with 5% noise -> Promote; 1.15 with the v3.6 spread (pair ratios 0.547–4.43) -> Inconclusive; identical arms -> A/A CI contains 1.0; same seed -> identical bits. CLI: Tier-L wall criterion is `NotEvaluated` unless >= 2 repetitions after a warmup (so never under Smoke); Tier-N wall criterion is always `NotEvaluated` (single sample per case). The existing fixed-screen timing calibrates from the fastest warmup (identical for the current one-warmup profiles).

## 3. Changed snapshots
No checksum or pinned value moved. Behaviour change in the smoke unified run: 11 joint verdicts move from hold to not-evaluated.

- **Re-audit 6.1 (independence in the bootstrap)**: the second bootstrap stage resampled pairs inside a case as if they were independent. Pairs from one process share its caches, frequency and allocator state, so the intervals came out too narrow.

pull_requests.title: WU-14: dense-output interior error control and fixed-step order contracts (F-002, F-018, F-020)
pull_requests.body:
Draft. Not for merge. Base: the audit base. Head: `c57b263` (sections 1–6 describe `e112543`; section 7 the re-audit follow-up).

## 1. Finding ids
- **F-002** (P2): RODAS5P dense-output interior error is never tolerance-controlled.
- **F-018** (P2): "fifth-order" gates never measure order on a stiff problem.
- **F-020** (P2): no tests for stiff order, dense-output accuracy on stiff problems, M != I order, FD f_t accuracy or integrator-level preconditioned paths.

## 2. Diff summary
- **F-002 (`f06afd5`)**: `DenseErrorControl {Off, Report, Enforce}` on the new `integrate_adaptive_dense_observed_with_dense_error_control`.
  - For every accepted step containing an interior output time, the estimate solves (M - (h/2) J) e = (h/2) d with d the interpolant defect at theta = 1/2 (one RHS, one Jacobian, one LU).
  - `Off` is the legacy path bit for bit, and the existing entry point keeps it. `Report` never changes the run and charges its work to the report. `Enforce` rejects steps whose estimate exceeds one unit.
  - Prothero-Robinson lambda = -1e5, rtol 1e-4 / 1e-6 / 1e-8: true interior max 3.2 / 312 / 209 tolerance units; Report estimate 2.7 / 263 / 162; under Enforce the true interior max is 0.92 / 1.05 / 1.38 (target <= 3).
  - `docs/DENSE_OUTPUT_ERROR.md`: order 4 nonstiff, about 3 stiff, not tolerance-controlled by default.
- **F-018 / F-020 (`e112543`)**: `tests/fixed_step_order_contracts.rs`, fixed h = 1/2^k, two-sided bands from E-04 / E-09, checked on in-tree problems:
  - direct LU, semilinear n = 16 and the M != I affine problem: two consecutive slopes >= 4.8;
  - PR lambda = -1e4: all pre-floor slopes in [2.7, 3.6], err(1/64) <= 1e-11; lambda = -1e2: last two in [3.8, 5.2];
  - FD f_t within 1e-6 of analytic; fixed-step error at most twice the analytic-f_t error;
  - GMRES with Jacobi and Direct preconditioners matches direct LU and keeps order 5;
  - forcing rule at fixed outer rtol, matrix-free semilinear n = 64: error <= max(3 x direct, 1 unit), plus a sentinel that some slope is < 4.5 (errors stall at 1e-2 .. 1e-5 units); invert it when a forcing rule that keeps order 5 lands;
  - rtol 1e-10 on stiff PR: typed roundoff-floor refusal at step 0 for h = 1/4 .. 1/32.
  - The h^6-coupled test is renamed `forced_fixed_step_with_h6_coupled_rtol_retains_order_five`, with a corrected comment.

## 3. Measured deviations from the audit's plan
- On small in-tree problems (n <= 32) the forcing arm keeps order 5 down to roundoff, because GMRES is exact there. The tolerance floor appears at n = 64, so T4/T5 use that size.
- The audit's E-04 P1 refused at every h at rtol 1e-10. On the in-tree 1-D PR the refusal covers h = 1/4 .. 1/32; at h = 1/64 and 1/128 the run completes within tolerance. The test pins both.

## 4. Changed snapshots
None.

## 5. Validation at `e112543`
With `RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1`. (Workspace count corrected in section 7.)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| fmt | clean |
| clippy (`-D warnings`) | clean |
| workspace (`--no-fail-fast`) | ~~456~~ 450 passed, 2 ignored (see section 7) |
| `cargo check --all-targets`, 3 feature sets | compiles |
| research | 327 passed |
| bateman | 333 passed |
| stage-certificate (whole crate) | 340 passed |
| stage-certificate clippy | clean |
| `--no-default-features` check | compiles |
| handoff validator and its tests | pass |
| ignored tests | wall-protocol test passes; v3.7 replay fails at its first literal, 17 vs 18, as on the base (F-003, handled on WU-13 #54) |

## 6. What remains unknown
- The fair-ab two-arm records do not carry an "interpolant error" label, because a new field would change sealed v2 checksums; the doc states it instead.
- The dense estimate needs a Jacobian (explicit or from JVP columns) and one LU per sampled step. Its cost on large matrix-free problems was not measured.
- This branch is on the audit base, so it does not include WU-3's forcing change (#46). The forcing sentinel may flip there.
- No performance claim.

## 7. Update after the second external re-audit (2026-09-29), head `c57b263`
- **RA-07 (cost of the dense estimate)**: the Jacobian-filtered interior estimate costs a Jacobian and an LU per sampled step, which a matrix-free run must not pay by default. `DenseErrorControl` now **defaults to `Off`**. A new `ReportDefect` mode records the unfiltered (h/2) M^{-1} d: one right-hand side, no Jacobian, no LU (a mass solve only when M != I). The run is unchanged.
  - Measured, Prothero-Robinson, 201 output times. Nonstiff lambda = -1, rtol 1e-6 / 1e-8: true interior 0.140 / 0.168, defect estimate 0.196 / 0.261. Stiff lambda = -1e5, rtol 1e-6: true 312, defect estimate 1.3e7 (the unfiltered |h lambda| factor).
  - Test `defect_report_needs_no_jacobian_and_overstates_stiff_components` asserts no Jacobian, LU or JVP work and agreement within a factor of 10 in the nonstiff case. `docs/DENSE_OUTPUT_ERROR.md` states each mode's cost and limits: `ReportDefect` is a cheap nonstiff indicator that overstates stiff components; only `Report` / `Enforce` are filtered.
- **Integration with WU-3**: on the integration branch the section 2 sentinels fire as expected. The forcing arm keeps order 5 at a fixed outer rtol (pre-floor slopes 4.95, 4.94), and rtol 1e-10 no longer aborts at step 0. The integration branch inverts the sentinel as its comment asks. The abort test becomes "completes at h = 1/4 .. 1/128 and agrees with the direct solve to 1e-6 relative". On this branch (audit base) they stay as written.

pull_requests.title: WU-13: holdout hygiene, reference-anchored safety labels, constant provenance, v3.5 erratum, v3.7 test split (F-047, F-045, F-046, F-023, F-003)
pull_requests.body:
Draft. Not for merge. Base: the audit base. Head: `1ac1871` (sections 1–5 describe `0877393`; section 6 the re-audit follow-up).

## 1. Finding ids
- **F-047** (P2): the frozen k=1 comparator replayed step indices read off earlier trajectories, including the N=512 holdout.
- **F-045** (P2): the atlas's "unsafe" label was the exponential shadow's own error estimate.
- **F-046** (P2): policy constants had no in-tree provenance.
- **F-023** (P2): the v3.5 "discriminating holdout" pass rests on one positive inside the one-rank backoff.
- **F-003** (P2): the sealed v3.7 replay test fails (17 vs 18), and no workflow runs ignored tests.

## 2. Diff summary
- **F-047 / F-045 / F-046 (`a94849d`)**
  - `FrozenK1Comparator` becomes `ReplayedK1Table` (serde alias `frozen-k1-comparator`, CLI alias `frozen-k1`). Its N=512 rows are deleted. On any holdout profile (`G4S5B0Profile::is_holdout`: canonical, holdout-512, holdout-320, holdout-384) it returns `InvalidInput`, including from the CLI.
  - New `CausalK1`: the K3 error-drop feature with a latch of one; its decisions depend only on past accepted steps (tested by perturbing later errors).
  - Each recommended shadow row now carries `reference_local_error_wrms`: the same (t, y, h) advanced by protected RODAS5P at 1e-3 times the case tolerances with 1e-13 GMRES solves, in the case WRMS norm. `reference_unsafe` = that error > 1. Reports add `reference_unsafe_recommendations`; `shadow_full_e_locally_admissible` is documented as a self-estimate. On the calibration-96 Robertson shadow the two rows read 4.0e-4 and 0.19 (self-estimates 0.019 and 0.084).
  - `docs/CONSTANTS_PROVENANCE.toml` classifies eight constants: V25 error-drop threshold and V29 stage-growth baseline **unsourced**; reserve 80, fraction 0.25, v3.7 cap 80 and the two CLI 1.15 thresholds **declared**; tau = 13.397 **fitted** on 24 candidates (n < 30). A test checks every value bit for bit against the source literal and a compiled registry, requires a row for every `V<digits>_` atlas constant, and checks cited artifact hashes. `enforced_prefix_jvp_cap` reads the named fraction instead of `/ 4`.
  - `docs/HOLDOUT_HYGIENE.md` states the rule.
- **F-023 (`f6d670e`)**: `tools/holdout_verdict.py` calls a verdict discriminating only with >= 5 positives and a verdict stable under a one-rank threshold move both ways. Replaying the v3.5 N=320 holdout: 28 events, 1 positive (HIRES, zeta34 = 14.32, rank 14), PASS at tau_final, FAIL at tau_selected and one rank up, so `INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_POSITIVES`. An appended erratum relabels v3.5 "survives, n_pos = 1, decided by the one-rank backoff".
- **F-003 (`62c7120`)**
  - The v3.7 test is split. Semantic invariants stay hard assertions. The literals 18 / 36 / 116 are retired by a tombstone (sealed 84a3b0f, first divergent ab8fbcd, cause intended-numerical-change, status NOT_REPRODUCIBLE_AT_HEAD_VALID_AT_SEALED_COMMIT).
  - A V2 snapshot pins today's 12 / 17 / 52 / 132 and prefix 120, with provenance; a numerical change adds a V3 file.

## 3. Diff summary
- **F-042 (`e93abca`)**: `matrix_exp_pade13` chooses squarings from the Al-Mohy–Higham alpha_p = max(d_p, d_{p+1}) with d_k = ||A^k||^(1/k), using the powers A^2, A^4, A^6 it already forms; above a 1e40 guard it keeps the old 1-norm path. Relative error after: 4.0e-16 .. 8.6e-15.
- **F-043 (`f217f70`)**:
  - The augmented operator divides its B block by sigma, the power of two at or above max_k |tau|^k ||b_k||, and starts the chain at sigma instead of 1. The physical block is unchanged; the augmented system is homogeneous in the input scale.
  - Convergence in `krylov_exponential_once` and `FusedPhiPrefixSession` is measured on the physical part only.
  - The adaptive fused path's phi error proxy is now the WRMS bound ||e||_2 / (sqrt(n) min w), not a division by ||w||_2.
  - The sigma = max_k ||b_k|| variant (without |tau|^k) was tried first and rejected: with b_k ~ v_k / h^k the tail swamped the physical part and a deliberately under-resolved adaptive test never accepted a step.
- **F-041 (`b8d7b7b`)**: `tests/exponential_order_contracts.rs`, a 3-D problem with non-commuting J and nonlinearity (time as a state):

- **Accepted steps:** the factor is proposed *before* the accepted error is recorded. Under `ControllerKind::Pi`, the "previous" error used to be the current one. The default controller is `Integral`, which does not use the history, so its output is bitwise unchanged; a guard test checks this.
- **Clipped trial with `trial_h / requested_h >= 0.5`** (`CLIPPED_SAMPLE_INFORMATIVE_RATIO`): this is now an error sample and enters the history.
  - If it predicts that the remembered request would be rejected, i.e. `error · (requested/trial)^q > 1`, the request drops to `clamp(candidate, trial_h, requested_h)`. It never drops below the accepted trial.
  - Otherwise the next request is `max(requested_h, candidate)`.
- **Sliver landing, `trial_h / requested_h < 0.5`:** the pre-clip request is returned unchanged, and the history is untouched, exactly as before.

Draft. Not for merge. This is the criterion and ledger part of WU-6; the clipped-controller part is #52. Head: `4bc37e0`.

## Update 2026-09-29: external audit VIG-A07

**RED commit `c94a371`.** Output before the fix:
- `classify_arm_budget(10, 1e-16, 10)` returned `WithinBudget`. The exact E + U is above B, so it must be `ReferenceUndecidable`.
- `with_case_tolerance` with weight ratio 1/3 and U = 1 gave `U_case = 0.3333333333333333 < 1/3`.

**Fix commit `4bc37e0`.**
- **Band comparisons:** the bands are decided on the exact E + U and E − U. `fl` is monotone and B is representable, so a rounded value strictly above or below B already decides the band. Only a rounded value equal to B uses the TwoSum error term. An overflowing sum exceeds any finite B.
- **Direction of the change:** rounding could not produce a false `ExceedsBudget` before. The exact comparison now also reports `ExceedsBudget` where the rounded difference landed exactly on B.
- **Case-tolerance conversion:** `with_case_tolerance` rounds both `w / w_case` and `U · ratio` upward. Each uses one FMA residual, or moves one step up where the residual could underflow.
- **Tests:** boundary cases on both sides of B. They cover U = 0, U of half an ulp, one ulp, and one ulp plus 2^-60. They also cover the ExceedsBudget side, and `E = U = B = f64::MAX`.
- The seven existing contracts pass unchanged, including the offline regression on the audit records.

## Update 2026-09-29: external audit VIG-A05 (directed division and square root)

**RED commit `2b5225d`.** It adds colocated unit tests in the evaluator module, where the helpers are private. Output before the fix:
```
subnormal_quotients_are_rounded_upward ... FAILED
  1 eta / 3 eta: 3.333333333333333e-1 is below 1/3
subnormal_square_roots_are_rounded_upward ... FAILED
  sqrt(3 eta): 1.7320508075688772e0 is below        (after scaling by 2^537)
normal_quotients_are_rounded_upward_and_exact_ones_kept ... FAILED
  upper_div(0, 3) returned the smallest subnormal, not 0
normal_square_roots_are_rounded_upward_and_exact_ones_kept ... ok
```

**Fix commit `d2a7326`.** `upper_div` and `upper_sqrt` decided the rounding direction from an FMA residual computed on the operands themselves. For tiny operands that residual underflows to -0.0, so the helper kept a value below the exact result.
- **Scaling:** both operands are now split exactly into `m 2^e` with `m ∈ [1, 2)`.
- **Residual:** the residual is computed on the significands, where it cannot underflow.
- **Result:** `fl(a/b)` and `fl(√x)` equal the reduced result times a power of two whenever the result is normal. A quotient below 2^-969 is still moved up unconditionally.
- **Zero:** `upper_div(0, b)` is now exactly 0.
- **Checked:**
  - For `k = 1..127`, `k η / 3η` and `√(kη)` return the least upper value.
  - Exact cases are kept: `6η / 3η = 2`, `√(4η) = 2^-536`, `1/4`, `√4`.
  - The 24 contracts in `audit2_stage_certificate_contracts.rs` pass unchanged.
- **Not checked:** I have no end-to-end certificate input where the old helper changed a decision, so this remains a helper-contract fix. The chain from these helpers through the norm and inverse-witness computation to a decision has no exact-oracle test yet. The Rocq/Lean files are unchanged by this update.

## 3. Diff summary
**Evaluator** (a9da327, then d2a7326):

- **F-060:** each stage has its own `StageCertificateStageSolve`. The state dimension `n` and the stage count `s` are validated separately.

  - `audit2_upper_add` and `audit2_upper_mul` round correctly upward, using TwoSum and FMA. Exact results are kept and overflow gives `NonFiniteBound`.
  - Residuals use `|fl(r_i)| + γ_{n+1}(|b_i| + Σ|a_ij x_j|) + (n+1)η`.

pull_requests.body:
Work unit WU-5 of the adversarial-audit handoff. Base: `audit/adversarial-audit-20260927` at `e1c3a5f`. Head: `51056ae`.

## Update 2026-09-29: external audit VIG-A01, VIG-A02, VIG-A06

**Correction.** The first version of this PR was validated with fmt, clippy and the default-feature workspace only. The feature suites were not run, and with `audit2-research` on the crate did not compile. CI job `audit2-feature-and-usage` (run 36437320131) failed on it. All feature suites now pass (section 5).

**VIG-A01**, commit `2ebca8d`. `exponential.rs:2899` failed to compile with E0282/E0283 when `audit2-research` was on: that feature adds several `From<_> for CoreError` impls, so the closure's error type could not be inferred. The closure result is now annotated as `CoreResult<(FusedPhiActionReport, Vec<f64>, Vec<f64>)>`. The failure was reproduced locally on Rust 1.94.1 first.

**VIG-A02**, commits `ba7ccfd` (RED) and `51056ae` (fix). Test matrix: `A = [[-2, 2^46], [2^-46, -2]]`, `v = e1`, `t = 1`. The eigenvalues are -1 and -3, and the exact result is `exp(-2)(cosh 1, 2^-46 sinh 1)`.
- **Before the fix:** the legacy path (min dimension 1, max 2) and the fused path (default dimensions) both reported `converged` with true error 7.349797e-2. The residual estimate was 6.1e-15.
- **Cause:** Arnoldi stopped whenever `h_{m+1,m} <= 1e3 eps max(1, |h_{i,m}|)`. That treats a nonzero residual as an invariant subspace, but `A` can feed such a residual back with a large gain.
- **Fix:** Arnoldi now stops early only when the residual is exactly zero. A small nonzero residual is normalized and extends the basis. The change is applied in the legacy path, `krylov_exponential_once` and the fused prefix session.
- **After the fix:** both paths reach the full two-dimensional space, with true error 4.08e-4.
- **Test tolerance:** the contract allows the requested threshold plus `eps ||tA||_1 ||exact||` (3.26e-3 here). `exp(tA)v` has relative condition of order `||tA||`, so no normwise backward-stable method reaches 1e-10 at `||A|| = 2^46`. Across the family `k = 0..52`, full-space results measured `≈ 0.15 eps ||tA||_1`. The hidden error was about 22 times the allowance.
- **Controls:**
  - `k ∈ {0,10,20,30,40,46,52}`, vector scale `1e-8..1e8`, `t ∈ {0.5, 1}`, on both paths;
  - an exactly invariant diagonal start, which still stops at dimension 1.

**VIG-A06**, same commits. `dense_phi_action(0, 1, [1e308])` returned an error because the normalizer was `2^ceil(log2 1e308) = 2^1024`, which is infinite. The exponent is now clamped to `[-1022, 1023]` and the power of two is built from its bits.
- **Tests:** largest finite vectors, subnormal and power-of-two vectors (within 4 eps + one subnormal ulp), and a result that really overflows, which still returns an error.

**Still open, not fixed here.**
- At an ordinary checkpoint, the KIOPS residual term is an estimate, not a bound. On the same 2×2 case with fused `minimum_dimension = 1`, or with `fused_phi_action_incremental` (prefix session), the result converges at dimension 1 with error 7.35e-2, both before and after this change.
- Separating "estimated convergence" from a certified forward-error bound in the public reports, for example by adding a second error-expansion term at the cost of one extra matvec, changes decisions and report schemas. That is left to the owner.
- `F-042` (Padé overscaling) remains open. The full-space errors above sit at its conditioning limit.

## 1. Finding ids

- `F-011` (P1): φ-action happy breakdown certifies a wrong result with `error_estimate = 0`.
- `F-040` (P2): the dense φ oracle puts the unscaled vector into the augmented Padé-13 matrix.
- `F-039` (P2): the work of failed adaptive-exponential trials is dropped from the counters.
- External audit 2026-09-29: VIG-A01, VIG-A02 (near-breakdown part), VIG-A06.

Not addressed here: `F-042`, `F-043` and `F-041`. See G4-FIX-3, -4 and -6 in `fixes/G4_exponential_phi.json`.

## 2. F-011 reproduced in Rust first

`A = diag(-1, -3)`, `v = e1 + 4.5e-7·e2`, `rtol = 1e-10`. At `0f64aa5`, source `e1c3a5f`:
```
legacy phi_0: converged=true happy_breakdown=true krylov_dimension=1 error_estimate=0.000e0 true_error=1.431e-7
fused exp:    converged=true substeps=1 krylov_dimension=1 error_estimate=0.000e0 true_error=1.431e-7
```

## 3. Failing tests before each fix

**`phi_action_certificate_contracts.rs`** (F-011, F-039):
- The legacy and fused understated-error tests failed as shown in section 2.
- `adaptive_fused_exponential_keeps_the_work_of_failed_trials`: `left: 3548, right: 6453`.

**`matrix_function_contracts.rs`** (F-040): scale invariance `7.010e-9` and diagonal accuracy `1.625e-9`.

**`phi_nonnormal_breakdown_contracts.rs`** (VIG-A02):
```
fused k=46: converged with true error 7.349797153304047e-2 > threshold 1e-10 + conditioning allowance 3.263019605775923e-3
legacy k=46: converged with true error 7.349797153304047e-2 > threshold 1e-10 + conditioning allowance 3.263019605775923e-3
legacy k=46 c=1e-8 t=0.5: converged with true error 4.69509687590894e-10 > threshold 1e-18 + conditioning allowance 3.240862577582371e-11
```

## 4. Diff summary

- **F-040:** `dense_phi_action` scales the augmentation column by an exact power of two and undoes the scaling on the result. VIG-A06 clamps that exponent.
- **F-011 / VIG-A02:**
  - A breakdown reports the Arnoldi residual term `|scale·h_{m+1,m}·β·e_mᵀ φ_{k+1}(scale·H_m) e_1|`, never 0.

pull_requests.title: WU-3: error-scaled inner forcing budget and no step-0 abort (F-009, F-008, F-031, F-030)
pull_requests.body:
Work unit WU-3 of the adversarial-audit handoff. Base: `audit/adversarial-audit-20260927` at `e1c3a5f`. Contains steps A, B and C.

## 1. Finding ids

- `F-009` (P1): the roundoff-floor guard aborts stage 0 on legal stiff input.
- `F-008` (P2): the stage-residual target `tau = 0.1/‖b‖₁` does not depend on `h`.
- `F-030` (P2): the order test ties `rtol` to `h^6` and cannot see the floor.
- `F-031` (P2), partly: the K-form rhs norm is inflated by `O(h|λ|)`. Step B states the floor in the rhs scale. The solution-relative diagnostic `rho_i` and the U-form lane from `fixes/G2_inner_forcing_rule.json` G2-3 are **not** done.

Evidence: `experiments/E-04/`. Design: `fixes/G2_inner_forcing_rule.json`.

## 2. Failing tests and output before the fix

New file `crates/rodas5p-integrators/tests/inner_forcing_fixed_step_ladder_contracts.rs`, commit `cce489e`. It holds the outer `rtol = 1e-6` fixed, halves `h` over 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, and requires the matrix-free inner-forced arm to stay within **3×** the direct-LU arm plus `1e-13` at every rung. The criterion is relative to direct LU, as the handoff asks, because stiff Prothero-Robinson shows order reduction even with exact solves. Problems: a diagonal vector Prothero-Robinson problem (E-04 `p1pr` with `Q = I`, `n = 128`, `λ ∈ [-1e6, -1]`) and semilinear advection-diffusion (E-04 `p2` reduced to `n = 128`).

Run at `cce489e` (source = `e1c3a5f`):

```
test forcing_target_on_a_stiff_stage_returns_a_floor_instead_of_an_error ... FAILED
test tight_rtol_stiff_fixed_steps_do_not_abort_at_step_zero ... FAILED
test inexact_arm_tracks_direct_lu_on_a_fixed_rtol_halving_ladder_advection_diffusion ... FAILED
  at h = 2^-4 the inexact arm error 7.021e-8 exceeds 3 x direct-LU error 1.279e-9;
  ladder (k, direct, inexact) = [(3, 4.64e-8, 4.64e-8), (4, 1.28e-9, 7.02e-8), (5, 3.52e-11, 3.82e-8)]
test inexact_arm_tracks_direct_lu_on_a_fixed_rtol_halving_ladder_prothero_robinson ... FAILED
  at h = 2^-4 the inexact arm error 1.529e-7 exceeds 3 x direct-LU error 3.492e-9;
  ladder = [(3, 5.38e-8, 1.03e-7), (4, 3.49e-9, 1.53e-7), (5, 2.08e-10, 2.02e-7)]
test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 4 failed
```

The existing h⁶-tied order test is kept and renamed to `forced_fixed_step_refinement_with_h6_tied_rtol_retains_order_five_before_roundoff`.

## 3. Diff summary

**Step B (`F-009`).** `rodas5p_inner_forcing_target` returned `Err` when `64 eps · rhs_wrms` exceeded the allocation, i.e. for `rhs_wrms > 1.4e12`, before any GMRES iteration. It now returns the same floor-limited `eta`/`tau` with a new `floor_active = true`, and the embedded estimate judges the step. Targets below the old abort condition are bit-identical.

**Step C (`F-008`).** The first stage-solve pass keeps the `h`-independent allocation `0.1/‖b‖₁`. Its embedded estimate `err` then bounds every stage budget:

```
tau_i <= 0.1/‖b‖₁ · min(1, err)^(6/5),   never below 64 eps · max(1, flow_wrms, rhs_wrms)
```

The exponent is `(p+1)/(q+1)` for RODAS5P (`p = 5`, `q = 4`), so the admitted residual scales like `h⁶` at a fixed tolerance. When any stage residual exceeds the bound, all stages are solved again, warm-started from the previous pass, because later stages depend on earlier ones. At most two refinements run and every pass is charged to the work counters. No history is needed, so `sequential_matrix_free_step_with_inner_forcing` keeps its signature and the adaptive driver (`integrate.rs`), dense output v2 and the regime atlas all use the rule.

- `StageInnerForcingReport` gains `floor_active` and `refinement_pass`.
- `rodas5p_inner_forcing_error_limit` and `RODAS5P_INNER_FORCING_ERROR_EXPONENT` are exported.
- New tests: the floor flag, the error limit, and refined-row reporting.

## Numerical contract

The candidate:

1. updates the projected least-squares system incrementally with stable real Givens rotations;
2. uses the projected left-preconditioned residual only as an advisory trigger;
3. builds a scratch candidate iterate without mutating the restart-cycle base;
4. accepts early only after the existing unpreconditioned true residual satisfies `max(atol, rtol * ||b||)`;
5. resets Givens state at every restart cycle;

A deliberately anisotropic preconditioner test proves that a false projected-residual trigger is rejected and the solve continues until the true residual is certified.

The exact-head candidate-only review found that `back_substitute` used an order-one floor in its triangular scale, incorrectly rejecting uniformly scaled but well-conditioned systems. The bounded correction now:

- derives the singularity tolerance from the actual maximum diagonal magnitude of `R`;
- rejects a genuinely all-zero triangular factor separately;
- verifies that `A = I` and `A = 1e-15 I`, with correspondingly scaled right-hand sides, return the same solution and convergence/work verdict.
